data.name: Aghlabah
data.gender_notes: Aghlabah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is brave and strong in battle. The name Aghlabah carries the meaning “Warrior” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Aghlabah usually hope their child will grow to embody warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the courage and strength of faith in Allah during times of challenge and adversity
data.etymology: Aghlabah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Warrior.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aghlabah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: أغلبة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يعني الغلبة والقوة والانتصار في المعاني العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أغلبة هو من الأسماء التي تعبر عن القوة والغلبة في اللغة العربية، ويرتبط بمعاني الانتصار والتميز. وقد وردت هذه الأسماء في بعض المصادر العربية القديمة، وتستخدم في بعض الأحيان في الأوساط الإسلامية كتعبير عن الصفات الحميدة.

in_urdu.name: اغلبہ

in_urdu.long_meaning: اغلبہ نام عربی زبان کی ایک اصطلاح ہے جو غلبہ، طاقت اور فتح کے معنی میں استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقالید میں بعض اوقات استعمال کیا جاتا ہے تاکہ ان کی اچھی صفات کا اظہار کیا جا سکے۔ عربی جڑوں سے اخذ کردہ، یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی معاشرے میں ایک خاص اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अग़ल्बाह
in_hindi.meaning: नाम जिसका अर्थ है प्रभुत्व, शक्ति और विजय
in_hindi.long_meaning: अग़ल्बाह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है प्रभुत्व, शक्ति और विजय। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में पारंपरिक महत्व रखता है और अक्सर अच्छे गुणों को व्यक्त करने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है। इसकी जड़ें इस्लामी परंपरा में हैं और यह नाम अरबी मूल से लिया गया है।

in_english.name: Aghlabah
in_english.meaning: Name means dominance, power, and victory in Arabic
in_english.long_meaning: The name Aghlabah originates from Arabic roots, signifying dominance, power, and victory. It is linked to positive attributes and has historical usage in Islamic tradition. Derived from the Arabic language, this name reflects strength and triumph, and is occasionally used in Muslim communities worldwide to signify good qualities.

data.cultural_impact: The Aghlabids were a Berber dynasty that ruled Ifriqiya (modern-day Tunisia) from 800 to 909 CE. Their name represents their military might and their ability to defend their territory against foreign invaders, highlighting their importance in protecting Islamic lands from external threats.
data.spiritual_significance: The name 'Aghlabah' also symbolizes the belief in courage and strength in the face of adversity, which is a core virtue in Islam. As Muslims, the Aghlabids and their followers were expected to strive for justice, defend the weak, and uphold the values of faith and morality. The name thus reflects their unwavering commitment to their beliefs and the courage with which they protected their lands and faith.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Warrior" symbolizes One who is brave and strong in battle. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Aghlabah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of warrior.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.context: This name has been carried by numerous pious Muslims throughout the centuries
